description: This file defines the public API for the SD subsystem in Zephyr OS, including enums, structures, and function prototypes related to SD card management.

methods.name: sd_init
methods.description: Initializes an SD device to use with the subsystem, returning 0 on success or an error code.

methods.name: sd_is_card_present
methods.description: Checks if an SD card is present in the slot, returning true or false.
